Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Class MailAttachment

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailAttachment
public final class MailAttachment extends Object
One attachment on a MailMessage: its file name, MIME type and size, plus (optionally) the bytes.

For an incoming message the metadata is filled while the envelope is listed but getData() stays null until the body is opened or the attachment is explicitly downloaded, so a folder full of large attachments does not blow up the list view. For an outgoing draft the bytes (or a File to read them from) are set when the user adds the attachment.
